mcp.instructions: LaughingFish MCP helps people plan time on the water. Each tool stands alone and does not know the others. You choose which to call. For a narrow question, call only the tool that answers it (weather, solar times, or location). For a plan on the water (boating, fishing, swimming, beach, what to expect), call every tool that applies to that place and time and write one answer from all results. Tomorrow uses weather hours 24. Next 3 days uses days 3. This week uses days 7. Convert relative dates to yyyy-MM-dd for solar times. Water temperature is not a tool yet; do not invent it. Use resolve_location only when you need coordinates by themselves. Use server_health only to verify the host. Never expose NOAA station names or station IDs.
